system_name: The island biogeography of the eBird citizen-science program

public_source.island_geometry_crosswalk: ISLAND_ID corresponds to OBJECTID in Sayre et al. 2018 global islands database
public_source.archive_description: 6573 RData files organized by month/day/year; each contains observed non-pelagic bird species, checklist submission ID, coordinates and ISLAND_ID

intake_issue: the archived-file description exposes observed-species rows but does not yet establish a frozen non-detection/absence surface or explicit checklist-completeness/effort fields sufficient for the source-loss persistence endpoint
